integrity.computational_evidence: Two standalone checkers included; direct semantics independently covers n<=4, weighted row-extrema census covers n<=5
integrity.proof_status: proved for stated all-length structural assertions; exhaustive finite calculations for n<=5
integrity.publication_status: research note; independent validation not performed
integrity.unproved_extensions: No general closed quotient-count or fibre-maximum formula; no claims for infinite orders

scientific_limitations: Uniform profile, reconstruction and sparse-representative results hold for arbitrary relations on finite chains; exact quotient and maximum-fibre counts were computed only through five worlds. They concern equality of induced operators on all upsets, not frame validity alone. Possible unindexed historical overlap remains; the 2023 canonical-condensation theory is an important prior general framework.
title: Four-modal observational profiles of finite intuitionistic chains
